rejected.headline: Palm City boaters raise concerns about parking space sizes at Charlie Leighton Park after $4.5 million renovation

lead_independence.headline: Palm City boaters raise concerns about parking space sizes at Charlie Leighton Park after $4.5 million renovation
lead_independence.lead: Some boaters say the new parking spaces at Charlie Leighton Park's boat ramp are too small for trucks towing larger boats after a $4.5 million overhaul that redid the ramp, added docks, and expanded parking.

rejected.headline: Port St. Lucie High School football player held in ICE custody after school zone speeding violation

lead_independence.headline: Port St. Lucie High School football player held in ICE custody after school zone speeding violation
lead_independence.lead: Emmanuel Nelson, 18, was stopped for driving 45 miles per hour in a 20-mile-per-hour school zone on August 19 and arrested by ICE three days later.
